thought: saw a masked animal trotting behind the visitor; surprise first
line: Megal! There's a masked little thing at your heels, human.

thought: the mask makes it look like a thief; half joking
line: Is that a raccoon, human, or a very small burglar?

thought: watching its paws handle things; gnomes measure cleverness against gnomes
line: Clever little hands on that creature, nearly as neat as a gnome's.

thought: compares it with the wildlife the Stronghold does have
line: We get squirrels in the branches here, but nothing in a mask.

thought: the masked creature makes her think of her larder
line: Must remember to latch the pantry tonight... no reason.

thought: her lunch was on the step a moment ago and the raccoon just passed
line: Where's my worm batta gone? It was on this step a moment ago.

thought: it's sniffing at her snack; shoos it in Gnomish
line: Kar, little one, those toad crunchies are mine, not yours.

thought: nudges a neighbour about the tail, then catches it looking
line: Here, look at that stripy tail. No, don't stare, it stares back.

thought: has heard where these creatures come from
line: They say those masked ones only follow folk who steal a great deal.

thought: worried it will climb the Tree; tells it so
line: Hello, stripy. The Grand Tree's for gnomes, not for climbing.

thought: it looks round every doorway it passes
line: It walks like it's counting the doors, that creature of yours.

thought: has heard about the redberry trick and doesn't quite believe it
line: Redberries turn those red, they say. I'd pay to see that.

thought: measures it by a glider ride
line: Would it sit still in a glider, do you think, or go through the bags?

thought: the gnome children will want to grab that tail
line: The children will be after that tail, so I'd keep it close.

thought: grumbles about creatures getting into everything
line: Squirrels in the roof, and now raccoons in the street. Whatever next?

thought: delighted surprise at a plump beaver
line: Great Guthix, a beaver, and a well-fed one at that!

thought: the coat is shiny; credits the owner sideways
line: Glossy coat on that beaver. Somebody looks after it properly.

thought: a builder animal; gnomes revere their great builder
line: Oaknock would have liked that beaver. A born builder, that.

thought: big shoulders on it; it has clearly chewed a lot
line: Must have chewed through a whole wood to get shoulders like that.

thought: fond of it, but trees come first
line: Hello, handsome. Anything you like, only not the Grand Tree.

thought: points out the teeth to a friend
line: Look at the teeth on that beaver. A proper worker, that one.

thought: the flat tail looks like a glider part
line: Fine flat tail on it. Our pilots would envy a rudder like that.

thought: has heard beavers only follow hard-working woodcutters
line: They say a beaver only follows the hardest-working woodcutters.

thought: it keeps to heel; the gnome children never do
line: Better trained than the gnome children, that beaver, and quieter.

thought: admires it while quietly guarding a young tree
line: Lovely creature... I'll just stand in front of this sapling a moment.

thought: the colour of its coat would make a good hat
line: Rometti would want that shade for a hat, I expect.

thought: the way it eyes the trees is how gnomes eye a drink
line: It looks at trees the way we look at a good cocktail, human.

thought: welcoming it to a place full of trees, a little nervously
line: We tend a lot of trees up here. It'll feel quite at home, I'm sure.

thought: a beaver at heel means the owner chops a lot
line: A beaver at heel. You must swing an axe like you mean it, human.

thought: has heard they change colour with logs
line: Feed it the right logs and it changes colour, they say. Clever beast.

thought: it has wings but walks; teases the owner for it
line: Wings, and it walks everywhere? It learnt that from you, human.

thought: measures the long legs against the agility course
line: Those legs would be round the agility course while you're on the log.

thought: it stands waiting like a heron does; the owner is the slow fisher
line: Standing on one leg, waiting for you to land a fish? It'll be a while.

thought: to a friend: the bird stands straighter than its owner
line: Look, that bird's got better posture than its owner.

thought: herons follow keen fishers; the catch is the bird
line: All that fishing, and the only thing you've landed is a heron.

thought: sympathy for the bird, aimed at the owner
line: Poor bird. All that fishing, and it's you who does the waiting.

thought: grey, gangly, wet; then turns it on the owner
line: Grey and gangly and dripping, and that's just the bird, human.

thought: a bird that could fly chooses to walk behind this one
line: A bird that could fly anywhere, and it chose to walk behind you.

thought: protective of the swamp toads gnomes catch
line: Keep that beak off the swamp, human, the toads there are spoken for.

thought: a water bird in a tree town baffles her
line: A fishing bird, up in a tree town. Who brings a fishing bird up here?

thought: backhanded: lovely bird, poor company
line: Handsome bird. It could do better for company, mind.

thought: there's a river smell, maybe not just the bird
line: Something smells of river, and I'm not sure it's only the bird.

thought: measures the bird against gnomeball
line: Long legs and a sharp beak. It'd beat you at gnomeball, that bird.

thought: has heard herons follow those who fish a great deal
line: They say a heron only follows those who've fished their life away.

thought: surprise, then wondering who is in charge
line: Megal, a heron! Did it follow you home, or did you follow it?

thought: a rock walking; exclaims
line: Great Guthix, your rock has legs, human!

thought: weight against a glider
line: That would sink a glider on its own, never mind with you aboard.

thought: small gnome feet next to a walking stone
line: Heavy little fellow. I'd not want it treading on my toes.

thought: the only stone figures gnomes know are statues
line: Oaknock's statues have the decency to keep still, at least.

thought: worried for the roots underfoot
line: Hello, little stone. Mind the roots, they were here first.

thought: unsettled; wants a drink
line: Walking rocks now. I need a Blurberry special and a sit-down.

thought: has heard golems follow keen miners
line: They say those only break loose for folk who mine a great deal.

thought: has heard about ore changing its colour
line: Feed it ore and it changes colour, they say. Dull diet, rocks.

thought: nudges a neighbour to look at the walking stone
line: Here, that big one's rock is following them. No, look, it walks!

thought: round and stony, like a ball on the pitch
line: Somebody will take it for a gnomeball one day and break a toe.

thought: it has left grit on her swept platform
line: Kar, grit all over the platform, and I'd only just swept it.

thought: wonders how a rock rests
line: Does it ever get tired, or does it just stop and be a rock again?

thought: magic is for the few gnomes who practise it
line: Brimstail might make sense of that. Magic's beyond most of us.

thought: its colour reminds her of gnome cooking
line: Brown as a worm batta, that rock. Let's hope nobody bites it.

thought: dry practical view of a following rock
line: A rock that follows you about. Saves carrying it, I suppose.

thought: no hair; the hat shop is the obvious cure
line: Rometti sells hats, human, and I think you know why I mention it.

thought: the head shines like fruit gnomes know well
line: Bald as a peeled orange, human, and about as shiny.

thought: the shine could be seen from the glider platform
line: The pilots could signal from the top of the Tree with that head.

thought: to a friend: the head gives off glare
line: Look at the shine off that head. Nobody stand under it at noon.

thought: the squirrels have noticed the head
line: The squirrels have been eyeing that head, human. Keep moving.

thought: so tall and so bald; muttering
line: All that way up and not a hair. Where do they grow them?

thought: the smooth head would blend in among toads
line: A head like that could hide in the swamp among the toads.

thought: bald humans always grumble about wind
line: Humans lose their hair and then complain of the wind. Every one.

thought: gnome children would want to touch it
line: The children will want to polish that, human, so walk quickly.

thought: exaggerates how far the shine carries
line: Megal! I could see that head from the top of the Grand Tree.

thought: gnomes wear pointed hats; prescribes one
line: A pointed hat would sort that, and hide the shine besides.

thought: compares the shine to polished bar glasses
line: Shinier than a glass at Blurberry's, that head.

thought: guesses the glider wind took it
line: Did it all blow off on the glider, human? It does happen.

thought: nothing for a hat to grip on the windy platforms
line: Nothing up top for a hat to grip. Mind the wind on the platforms.

thought: the head would light the platform
line: You'd make a lovely lamp for the glider platform, human.

thought: practical: the clothes shop is upstairs
line: Rometti's a floor up in the Grand Tree, human, if you're looking.

thought: light for a glider, odd for the pilot
line: Lighter for the glider, I suppose, though the pilot may object.

thought: embarrassed, eyes shut until they pass
line: Don't look, don't look... right, they've gone past.

thought: children about; warns a neighbour
line: Cover the children's eyes, there's a big one with nothing on.

thought: the rope nets would leave marks on bare skin
line: Mind the nets on the agility course, human. They'll leave a pattern.

thought: evenings are cold high up
line: It gets cold up on the platforms of an evening, just so you know.

thought: surprise; assumes theft
line: Megal! Has somebody pinched your clothes, human?

thought: a cocktail with a cold name won't help
line: A wizard blizzard won't warm you, whatever it sounds like.

thought: climbing the branches bare
line: Nothing to catch on the branches, at least. That's one way to climb.

thought: the grocer won't help with this
line: Hudo sells dough, human, not trousers, I'm afraid.

thought: gnomes wear green; any colour would do
line: We wear green here, mostly, but any colour would be a start.

thought: quietly to a friend
line: Here, don't look now, but the tall one's forgotten everything.

thought: guesses at human warmth, wryly
line: Big folk run warm, I'm told, but that's a good deal of warm.

thought: this happens every summer with visitors
line: Every summer it's the same. One of them always forgets the lot.

thought: tortoises go bare too, but have shells
line: The war tortoises go about bare too, but they've a shell.

thought: the fashionable tailor would turn this away
line: Rometti wouldn't let that outfit through his door, human.

thought: compares the outfit to swamp toads
line: Even the swamp toads are better turned out, human.

thought: a cocktail is out of reach for this purse
line: Saving up for a fruit blast, human? Keep saving.

thought: they look thrown out of something
line: Did you come by glider, or did the glider throw you out?

thought: to a friend, about the patched clothes
line: Look at the state of that outfit. Patched by goblins, surely.

thought: points them at paid work, pointedly
line: Hudo pays well for giant frog legs, and you look like you need it.

thought: gnome children have better boots
line: Gnome children have better boots, human, and they outgrow theirs.

thought: so much person, so little money
line: All that height and not a coin on it. Where does it all go?

thought: there is little to lose in a gnomeball tackle
line: Nothing much to tear in a gnomeball tackle, at least.

thought: grumbling about penniless visitors
line: Adventurers. Never a coin on them, and always after a glider.

thought: gnome pride in oranges; this one can't buy one
line: Gnomes brought oranges to Gielinor, human, and you can't run to one.

thought: the clothes look ancient
line: That outfit's seen more seasons than the Grand Tree, I'd say.

thought: the clothes look chewed
line: Megal, did something chew those clothes, human?

thought: if this is their best, washing day must be worse
line: If that's your best, human, I'd hate to see you on washing day.

thought: worn soles; must be hard walking
line: Must be hard going, all that walking, with soles like those.

thought: plenty of fine kit, worn well
line: That's a lot of good kit on one human, and you wear it well.

thought: the gear brightens the platform
line: Megal! The whole platform's gone brighter since you came up.

thought: better dressed than the king; asks for discretion
line: The King doesn't dress half so well, and don't tell him I said so.

thought: prices it against a glider
line: Must've cost more than a glider, all that, and it suits you better.

thought: to a friend, admiring the cut
line: Here, look at the cut of that one's gear. Proper, that.

thought: bright enough to guide a glider in
line: Shiny enough to land a glider by, human, and I mean that kindly.

thought: feels underdressed by comparison
line: I'll need a new hat if they're all going to look like that.

thought: guesses at their success abroad
line: Somebody's been doing well for themselves out there, haven't they?

thought: children stopping to stare
line: Even the gnome children have stopped to look, human.

thought: pictures them on a war tortoise
line: You'd not look out of place on a war tortoise, dressed like that.

thought: rare sight in the Stronghold
line: We don't often see gear like that up here, human. It's a treat.

thought: heavy gear yet they move lightly
line: All that and still light on your feet? Well done, human.

thought: fit for the grandest table
line: You'd be welcome at any table in the Grand Tree, dressed so.

thought: good work, though not gnome work
line: Fine work on that, whoever made it. Not gnome work, but fine.

thought: deserves a drink to go with it
line: Good gear deserves a good cocktail, and Blurberry's is just up there.

thought: they look hurt and thin; the gnome question
line: Are you eating properly, human? You look half done in.

thought: prescribes gnome food and rest
line: A worm hole and a sit-down, that's what you want, human.

thought: alarm at the blood
line: Oh dear, oh dear, that one's leaking. Somebody fetch a bandage.

thought: to a friend: they walk crooked
line: Don't stare, but the big one's walking like a broken glider.

thought: blood on boots; guesses at a bite
line: Blood on your boots, human. Been somewhere with teeth, I expect.

thought: offers a rest
line: Sit on the step a while. Nobody's in a hurry here but the gliders.

thought: pale like dough from the grocery
line: Pale as Gianne dough, human, and that's not a good colour on you.

thought: so weak a child could topple them
line: A gnome child could knock you over just now, so mind them.

thought: a blessing from the gnomes' god
line: Guthix keep you, human. You look ready to topple.

thought: big folk never feed themselves
line: Big folk never eat enough, and look what comes of it.

thought: thinks of a hearty dish to cook for them
line: Tangled toad's legs, that's what's wanted. Where's that recipe...

thought: they sway in the breeze
line: Megal, you're swaying like a branch in a gale.

thought: hopes the other party fared worse
line: Whatever you met out there, I hope it looks worse.

thought: the Tree as a place to rest
line: The Tree's a quiet place to mend, human, if you can find a corner.

thought: to a friend, before they fall
line: Here, fetch a chair for that one before they fall over.

thought: gnomes walk the ramp; the human is panting
line: Nobody runs up the ramp to the Tree, human. We stroll, and we arrive.

thought: red and wobbly like a cocktail
line: Red as a drunk dragon, human, and nearly as wobbly.

thought: running is for the course, not the street
line: Sit down a moment, human. Running's for the course.

thought: muttering about human stamina
line: All that panting. Do they not have legs where they come from?

thought: to a friend, the wheezing
line: Listen to that one wheeze, like a bellows with a hole in it.

thought: sounds like a long run, uses the pilots' name for Karamja
line: Sounds like you've run all the way from Gandius, human.

thought: balance and steady breath
line: Slow breaths, human. Balance in all things, Guthix willing.

thought: the trainers' famous jibe
line: The trainers would say their granny moves faster, and mean it.

thought: gliding saves the legs
line: Take the glider next time, human. It does the work for you.

thought: heard them coming from far off
line: Megal, the puffing! I heard you coming from the gate.

thought: big folk rush and suffer for it
line: Big folk always rush, and then they wonder why they're puffed.

thought: offers the rail to lean on
line: Lean on the rail a moment. The platforms aren't going anywhere.

thought: even slow creatures pace themselves
line: Even the war tortoises stop for a breather, human.

thought: guesses they lost a race
line: Been racing the terrorbirds, human? They do tend to win.

thought: this is why gnomes glide
line: Puff, puff, puff. And they wonder why we fly gliders.

thought: gnomes are armed; this one isn't, really
line: Most gnomes carry a bow, human. You might borrow one.

thought: terrorbirds would make short work of them
line: Walk round the terrorbirds, human. They'd have you for breakfast.

thought: a tortoise wouldn't notice them
line: A war tortoise would walk right over you and never notice.

thought: gnomeball's low bar for success
line: Leaving gnomeball in one piece counts as doing well. You'd struggle.

thought: the grip on the weapon is nervous
line: You hold that weapon like it might bite you, human.

thought: to a friend: unscarred, and not from skill
line: Not a scratch on that one, and not from skill, I'd say.

thought: goblins trouble gnomes; this one wouldn't trouble goblins
line: Goblins give us trouble, human, and you'd give them none.

thought: too feeble even to shout at
line: The trainers wouldn't even shout at you, human. They'd just sigh.

thought: muttering about the varieties of big folk
line: Big folk come in all sorts, and that's one of the softer sorts.

thought: the weapon is a danger to its owner
line: Kar, put that down before you hurt yourself, human.

thought: balance tips towards harmless
line: Guthix likes balance, and you're tipping well towards harmless.

thought: looks like they once lost to a chicken
line: You look like you were chased by a chicken once, and lost.

thought: offers a gnome child as an escort
line: Shall I fetch a gnome child to walk you through the woods, human?

thought: the gate guards wouldn't bother with them
line: The guards on the gate waved you through without a look, I expect.

thought: mistakes the weapon for a stick
line: Megal, is that a weapon? I took it for a walking stick.

thought: proud of how far the Tree's roots run
line: The Tree's roots reach Grandroot Bay, you know. Long way for a root.

thought: the bar will be busy later
line: Blurberry's will be busy tonight. It always is.

thought: her lunch has gone cold while she chats
line: My worm batta's gone cold again. Talking does that to a batta.

thought: the explorers are off again
line: Narnode's explorers are off to the far corners again, they say.

thought: pride in the old engineer's work
line: Oaknock built most of this place long ago, and it's held up nicely.

thought: gnomes never get credit for oranges
line: We brought oranges to Gielinor, and nobody ever says thank you.

thought: the agility trainers are loud
line: The trainers are shouting again. You can hear them from the Tree.

thought: muddling a cocktail recipe
line: Lemon, then pineapple... no, that's the wrong punch again.

thought: a gnomeball game later; mind the shins
line: Gnomeball on the field this evening. Mind your shins if you watch.

thought: fond of the slow war tortoises
line: Nacklepen's tortoises are slow, but they always get there.

thought: the spirit tree thinks
line: The spirit tree south of here thinks, you know. Slowly, but it thinks.

thought: the Digsite glider always crashes
line: The glider to Lemanto Andra crashes every landing. One way only.

thought: old king led them up from below; height pun
line: Healthorg led us up from underground, and we've not looked down since.

thought: balloons land near her washing
line: The balloons come down south of the Tree, smoke and all. My washing!

thought: pity for the ambassador in a stone castle
line: We keep a gnome at King Roald's court. All that stone, poor soul.

thought: dead leaves out of season
line: Brown leaves on the Grand Tree at this time of year... it isn't right.

thought: Glough blames humans for everything
line: Glough says it's humans doing it. Glough says that about everything.

thought: the argument over the cause
line: Some say sabotage, some say it's closer to home. Nobody knows.

thought: the Tree is home; explains the gloom
line: Most of us live in that Tree, human, so pardon the long faces.

thought: the king asking outsiders shows how bad it is
line: Narnode's asking humans for help now, so it must be bad.

thought: to a friend: a newcomer, and Glough won't like it
line: Another big one in town, and Glough already muttering about it.

thought: suspicion is in the air
line: You've not been near the roots, have you? Only, people ask.

thought: her own small precaution
line: I water the saplings twice over now, in case it's catching.

thought: another leaf falls
line: Megal, another leaf down. That's not autumn, that's the Tree.

thought: the roots are sick; tread carefully
line: Mind where you tread, human. The roots are poorly enough.

thought: the king is worn with worry
line: The King looks worn thin, worrying over that Tree.

thought: Glough watches humans instead of curing the tree
line: Glough's eyeing every one of you big folk, as if that'll cure a tree.

thought: the Tree by its old name, sick
line: Ta Quir Priw, sick. I never thought I'd say it.

thought: anxious it might be her fault
line: Is it something I did? I only ever watered it...

thought: points out the thinning canopy
line: Megal, look at the canopy, human. Thinner than it ought to be.

thought: the Tree is well; a quiet thanks
line: Good to see you about, human. The Tree's never looked better.

thought: recognises the one who dug out the rocks
line: Megal, it's the one who dug the rocks out of our roots!

thought: has heard about the black demon
line: They say you saw off a black demon under our Tree. Thank you, human.

thought: they may fly the gliders now
line: You may fly our gliders now, human. Not every big one gets that.

thought: to a friend: that's the one
line: That's the one who saved the Tree, that is. Wave, go on.

thought: the war that nearly was
line: There was talk of war with your lot until you set it straight.

thought: Glough's warship plan, foiled
line: Glough wanted our Tree for warships, and you stopped him, human.

thought: she still checks the Tree every day
line: Green again, all the way up. I still check it every morning.

thought: the new guardian is friendly to big folk
line: Daero's head guardian now, and he's glad of big folk like you.

thought: the whole race shelters in the Tree
line: The whole race sleeps easier under that Tree because of you.

thought: shock that it was Glough
line: Glough, of all gnomes. Good thing you had your eyes open, human.

thought: deserves the best cocktail
line: If anyone's earned a Blurberry special, human, it's you.

thought: Glough is shut up now
line: Word is Glough's shut up in his own treehouse now, thanks to you.

thought: the Tree by its old name, healthy
line: Ta Quir Priw stands green and tall, and that's your doing.

thought: they went down to the roots
line: You went down among the roots for us, human. We don't forget that.

thought: honorary member of the squad
line: Garkor made you one of the squad, they say. No small thing, human.

thought: the monkey disguise
line: Word is you went about Ape Atoll as a monkey, and nobody guessed.

thought: charm plus nerve
line: Zooknock's charm and your nerve, human. That fooled the monkeys.

thought: honorary gnome soldier, much taller than one
line: An honorary gnome soldier, and taller than the whole squad together.

thought: recognises them: the demon fight
line: Megal, it's the one who stood with the squad against the demon!

thought: to a friend: that's the one who found the squad
line: That's the one who found the squad. Taller in person.

thought: trained by Daero
line: Daero trained you himself, I hear. Quicker than most big folk now.

thought: indignant at the monkey king's plotting
line: Awowogei plotting against us all along! Good thing somebody went.

thought: the storm that downed the squad didn't stop them
line: The winds that downed the squad's gliders didn't stop you, human.

thought: muttering amazement that a big one did it
line: The tenth squad found, and by one of the big folk. Megal.

thought: our soldiers lost, found by this one
line: Our soldiers went missing, and it took you to find them, human.

thought: would be a fine soldier, if a helmet fit
line: You'd make a fine gnome soldier, human, if we had a helmet to fit.

thought: back from Ape Atoll whole
line: Ape Atoll and back in one piece, human! Not many can say that.

thought: to a friend: the good kind of monkey
line: Look, it's the monkey one. No, the good sort of monkey one.

thought: the squad's debt
line: Sergeant Garkor's lot owe you, human, and so do the rest of us.

thought: Glough has vanished from his treehouse
line: Glough's gone from his treehouse, and nobody saw him go, they say.

thought: pity for his sweetheart
line: Poor Anita. Sweet on Glough, and now he's vanished on her.

thought: the king wants the one who stopped him before
line: The King keeps asking if that adventurer's come back yet.

thought: the treehouse is to be searched
line: Someone's to search that treehouse for clues. Rather them than me.

thought: who was guarding him?
line: Under house arrest, and gone. Who was minding the door?

thought: avoids the treehouse now
line: I take the long way round Glough's treehouse now. Just in case.

thought: jumpy at every noise
line: Every creak in the branches, and I think it's him.

thought: keeps imagining him in the swamp
line: I keep thinking I see him in the swamp. It's a toad, every time.

thought: old gossip about the balloon man
line: Le Smith flew gliders once, they say, till he got too full of hot air.

thought: life goes on regardless
line: Glough loose, and the gliders running as if nothing's wrong.

thought: dry joke about house arrest
line: House arrest, they called it. Seems the house didn't agree.

thought: separate houses, now none
line: Glough and Anita kept separate houses, they say. Now he's kept none.

thought: a bad week for the Stronghold
line: Rough week in the Stronghold, what with Glough gone missing.

thought: the guards failed
line: If the guards can't keep one gnome in his house, what are they for?

thought: balloons still go up regardless
line: Balloons still going up south of the Tree, Glough or no Glough.

thought: Anita has moved on
line: Anita's walking out with Carado now, they say. Glough who?

thought: Garkor lives in Glough's old house
line: Garkor's moved into Glough's old treehouse. Bit of a turnaround, that.

thought: a glider to the monkeys now
line: A glider to Ape Atoll! A year ago we'd have called that madness.

thought: the balloon man helped Glough
line: Le Smith, the balloon man! Smuggled Glough out under our noses.

thought: gorillas loosed from the airship
line: They say gorillas were dropped on us from a flying ship.

thought: the wreck and what's under it
line: The wreck's still out north, they say, and demonic gorillas under it.

thought: she passes Nieve's grave
line: Nieve's grave is up by the swamp. I go past it most mornings.

thought: Nieve's cousin has her post
line: Nieve's young cousin has her post by the cave now. Steve, his name is.

thought: Glough was a gnome once
line: Strange to think of Glough as a monster. He was a gnome once, like us.

thought: two kings making peace
line: Awowogei and Cinqo Narnode at peace! I never thought I'd see it.

thought: the squad mage by the pitch
line: Zooknock's up by the gnomeball field now. Hope he likes noise.

thought: still jumpy at things in the sky
line: I still look up whenever a balloon goes over. Can't help it.

thought: the brew that made monsters
line: Glough's brew made monsters of gorillas, they say, and then of him.

thought: the squad fought in the Stronghold
line: The tenth squad fought gorillas in our own north-west corner.

thought: someone was with Nieve at the end
line: Word is an adventurer was down in that cavern with Nieve at the end.
